# Ash generated-function fixture

This minimal Ash/Spark app exercises public functions generated by an
`Ash.Resource` code interface. Compile it with the repo's mise toolchain:

```sh
cd internal/lsp/testdata/ash_generated_functions
mise exec -- mix deps.get
mise exec -- mix compile
```

Then run the opt-in integration test from the repository root:

```sh
mise exec -- go test ./internal/lsp -run AshGeneratedFunctionsIntegration
```
